title: Sabah had the largest mean/median ratio in 2024: 1.329, a 32.9% gap (RM1,608); its Gini was 0.405.
subtitle: Gross monthly household income; current-year RM, mean/median ratio and Gini (0–1); 2016, 2019, 2022, 2024
notes: Gap % uses median as denominator; ratio and Gini describe different aspects of a distribution.
A larger mean/median ratio signals skew, not a measured causal relationship or a complete inequality ranking.
headline: Sabah had the largest mean/median ratio in 2024: 1.329, a 32.9% gap (RM1,608); its Gini was 0.405. This indicates skew, not a complete inequality ranking.
